concerns.text: T021a restricts correlation analysis to the 'training subset only' to prevent leakage. This violates SC-002 and FR-008 which require correlation tests against the 'full dataset context' (or at least a representative sample excluding the hold-out) to establish global significance. Restricting to training data alone weakens the exploratory analysis requirement.

T022 includes a fallback to 'log a warning' and save an empty/null VIF file if calculation fails. FR-012 mandates running collinearity diagnostics. Allowing the pipeline to complete without VIF results (even if empty) violates the mandatory nature of this diagnostic requirement unless the spec explicitly allows 'skip on failure' (which it does not).

T017 is marked as 'FAILED: unspecified' in the task list itself. A task that explicitly states it failed to generate required artifacts (batch_corrected_matrix.csv, etc.) cannot satisfy FR-001 through FR-014. This represents a silent relaxation of the requirement to produce valid processed data before modeling.

T012a and T012b are marked as 'REJECTED' and 'unverifiable' due to missing artifacts. Since downstream tasks (T017, T020) depend on these artifacts, the task list describes a broken execution path that cannot satisfy the data acquisition requirements (FR-001, FR-014).

T028 is marked as 'REJECTED' with missing visualization artifacts. FR-010 and SC-004 imply visual evidence is part of the deliverable. Marking the task as rejected while the pipeline proceeds violates the requirement to produce the specified output.
